phase_definition: Valid labelled grasp attempts before the final hand-closing/grip tuning. Includes Z, wrist/table-clearance, distance, and hand-strength failures.
notes: Historical calibration evidence. Do not present as final performance.

phase_definition: Valid labelled grasp attempts after the log explicitly records the hand weak-grasp fix or higher XL-320 command range, but before the latest demo run.
notes: Shows improvement after grip tuning, but still needs repeated controlled trials.

phase_definition: Latest labelled post-calibration demonstration phase from the newest available first-person trial evidence.
notes: Representative latest successful dice/cube grasp/lift evidence; sample size is too small for a final rate.

phase_definition: Rows that are unlabelled, non-grasp, pending annotation, or not confidently assignable to a calibrated phase.
notes: To be reviewed or excluded from success-rate claims until manually labelled. Total rows in this bucket: 15.
